description: Réseau de fibre optique gironde numérique is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Gironde numérique. layout of the fibre optic network managed by the mixed union gironde digital on the department of Gironde. Coverage: Gironde numérique. The portal shows the English title as "Digital gironde fiber optic network" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Gironde numérique. Its keywords include gironde, reseau-internet, fibre-optique. The listing shows 3 download or service links in KML, CSV, SHAPE. The listing shows 2015-12-26 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/summary/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
